title: Integrated bulk and single-cell transcriptomics with virtual knockout analysis identifies FOS as an epithelial-associated candidate gene in chronic atrophic gastritis.
authors: Li, Shilong; Duan, Huiqiang; Liu, Xin; Shan, Meihua; Shen, Zexuan; Wu, Mingze; Wang, Peiyao; Yao, Qianze; Fu, Weihua
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组与单细胞数据及虚拟敲除、分子对接识别CAG中FOS基因，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（FOS为转录因子）和分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物发现而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法以组学分析和简单对接为主，深度不足。
abstract: Chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG) is a precancerous lesion characterized by epithelial injury, glandular atrophy, and impaired gastric function. Molecular targets linking epithelial alterations with potential traditional Chinese medicine-derived compounds remain unclear. GEO bulk transcriptomic datasets were analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs), which were intersected with CAG-related genes for enrichment analysis. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis and reverse network pharmacology were used to identify key targets and construct a drug-component-target network. Single-cell RNA sequencing, virtual knockout, molecular docking, CCK-8 assay, and RT-qPCR in 1‑Methyl‑3‑nitro‑1‑nitrosoguanidine (MNNG)-treated GES-1 cells were then integrated to prioritize and evaluate FOS. A total of 502 DEGs and 54 intersected CAG-related genes were identified, with enrichment in wound healing, epithelial junction organization, tight junctions, cAMP signaling, gastric cancer, and digestive or secretory pathways. Five key genes-APOA1, CFTR, FOS, HMOX1, and VIM-were identified, all with AUCs above 0.80. Among 21,679 single cells, FOS was the only key gene predominantly enriched in gastric epithelial cells. Virtual knockout predicted associations between FOS-network perturbation and five genes involved in hormone processing and gastric secretory pathways. Docking generated candidate fisetin-FOS and kaempferol-FOS poses for preliminary compound prioritization. MNNG reduced GES-1 cell viability and significantly increased FOS mRNA expression. Integrated computational analyses highlighted FOS as an epithelial-associated candidate gene in CAG and suggested exploratory associations with gastric secretory pathways. These findings support further functional and compound-intervention studies of the FOS/AP-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 慢性萎缩性胃炎（CAG）是一种癌前病变，其特征为上皮损伤、腺体萎缩及胃功能受损。连接上皮改变与潜在中药来源化合物的分子靶点仍不明确。分析了GEO批量转录组数据集以识别差异表达基因（DEGs），并将其与CAG相关基因取交集进行富集分析。利用蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析和反向网络药理学来识别关键靶点并构建药物-成分-靶点网络。随后整合了单细胞RNA测序、虚拟敲除、分子对接、CCK-8实验及在1-甲基-3-硝基-1-亚硝基胍（MNNG）处理的GES-1细胞中的RT-qPCR，以优先排序并评估FOS。共鉴定出502个DEGs和54个交集CAG相关基因，富集于伤口愈合、上皮连接组织、紧密连接、cAMP信号、胃癌及消化或分泌通路。识别出五个关键基因——APOA1、CFTR、FOS、HMOX1和VIM，其AUC均高于0.80。在21,679个单细胞中，FOS是唯一主要富集于胃上皮细胞的关键基因。虚拟敲除预测了FOS网络扰动与参与激素加工和胃分泌通路的五个基因之间的关联。对接生成了候选的漆黄素-FOS和山柰酚-FOS构象，用于初步化合物优先排序。MNNG降低了GES-1细胞活力并显著增加FOS mRNA表达。综合计算分析强调FOS为CAG中上皮相关的候选基因，并提示与胃分泌通路的探索性关联。这些发现支持对FOS/AP-1轴进行进一步的功能和化合物干预研究。
